comments.author: Anna Weber (Accounting)
comments.body: Could we use a semicolon as the separator instead of a comma? Our bookkeeping tool expects `;`, and several customer names contain commas.

comments.author: Dev Example
comments.body: Yes, let's use semicolons, as in decision [24A] of the export spec. And please make sure customer names with quotes (we have `Bäckerei "Zum Korn"`) don't break the file.
